name: @tomgrv/app-coder
description: Coder (remote development environments) with in-cluster PostgreSQL

CODER_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first Coder admin (empty = admin@<wildcard domain>)

CODER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first Coder admin (empty = generated and saved)

CODER_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username of the first Coder admin

CODER_CHART_VERSION.description: Coder chart version to pin (e.g. 2.37.4; empty = latest)

CODER_DB_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password for Coder (empty = generated and saved)

CODER_WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace workspaces run in (created; Coder's service account gets rights there)

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_BUILDER_REF.description: devcontainer-builder tag/commit of the Coder template to push (else the starter)

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_BUILDER_VERSION.description: devcontainer-builder chart version to pin (empty = latest, logged)

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY.description: External registry host (with the token, user and org); no default, the local registry is used when unset

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY_ORG.description: External registry org/user the images are pushed under

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY_TOKEN.description: External registry token able to push and pull (GHCR: write:packages)

CODER_DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY_USER.description: External registry username for the token

ZZ_SECRETS_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding the credentials the steps generate
